text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm shopping at the mall...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Agh! What am I going to do?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I received some gifts a while back, and I
want to
return the favor, but I'm
stumped on what to get.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hang on! Since you're here, can I ask
you for
help?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So... it's not just one person I want to
thank... It's
more like a whole crowd!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But obviously they all like different
things, so I
can't think of anything that'll
suit all of them.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hm... They come over to my parents'
place often, so I was thinking it'd be
good to get something
they can all
share, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
They are! They all look up to my dad,
and they've
always shown me a lot of
love too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
In fact, they're always sending me gifts
and letters
to cheer me on!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Reading those letters always fills me
with such
warm and fuzzy feelings!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So it's only fair that I get them
something that'll
fill them with the same
warm, happy feeling
they've given me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hm... What would make them happy?
Ah.
choice_data_list: Haven't you already found the answer?
Don't you already have your answer?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've got it!
Winning a bunch of races'll be
the best
way to pay them back!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right! Instead of buying a physical
gift for
them, I'll invest in something to
help me win my
races!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Yeah, having good equipment is
essential!
choice_data_list: A high-quality pair of shoes might...
A training manual seems like a goo...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Okay! With a new pair of shoes on my
feet, I'll
leave the competition in the
dust!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hm, that's a good point! Studying is the
key to
winning!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right,
I'll buy a book and read it from
cover to
cover!
